anatomyDims.label: Left Brain
anatomyDims.desc: How the developer thinks, plans, and directs its growth — clarity and distinctiveness of strategic vision, reflected across projects, communication, and customer experience.

anatomyDims.label: Heart
anatomyDims.desc: The emotional territory the developer owns in consumers’ minds — the strength and consistency of that emotional connection.

anatomyDims.label: Legs
anatomyDims.desc: The developer’s ability to expand, evolve, and sustain future growth — footprint inside/outside Cairo and outside Egypt, plus presence in commercial and hospitality.

anatomyDims.label: Right Brain
anatomyDims.desc: Capacity to introduce new ideas, products, and masterplans — product innovation, lifestyle innovation, masterplanning innovation.

anatomyDims.label: Mouth
anatomyDims.desc: How clearly and powerfully the developer communicates its brand to the market — innovation and frequency of communication efforts.

anatomyDims.label: Muscles
anatomyDims.desc: Resources it leverages to build, deliver, and commercialize — construction capability, delivery reliability, commercial/hospitality muscle.

anatomyDims.label: Hands
anatomyDims.desc: Facility and community management — community engagement (apps, events) and facility management (landscape, security).

archetypes.desc: Seeks knowledge, truth and deeper understanding; rational, informed and fact-driven.
Seeks independence, discovery and new experiences; dislikes restriction.
Challenges conventions and established norms; bold, independent and disruptive.
Focused on transformation and possibility; turns ambition into exceptional outcomes.
Motivated by achievement, competence and overcoming challenges.
Seeks emotional fulfilment, meaningful relationships, beauty and connection.
Brings energy and spontaneity; seeks fun and positive experiences.
Seeks connection, familiarity and community; values authenticity and accessibility.
Focused on supporting, protecting and nurturing others; creates comfort and wellbeing.
Seeks stability, authority and control; values order and excellence.
Driven by originality and self-expression; turns ideas into something distinctive.
Seeks safety, simplicity and optimism; drawn to trustworthy, comfortable environments.

essenceLayers.v: What is objectively true about the developer? Heritage, portfolio, reach, capabilities, delivery record, communication.
What does that reality give customers — and how does it make them feel? Convenience, confidence, safety, belonging, choice, status.
If the developer were a person, how would it naturally behave and come across? Expert, approachable, bold, caring, refined, reassuring.
What principles consistently guide its choices and relationships? Trust, community, ambition, innovation, responsibility, quality.
The shortest, most distinctive expression that unifies all four layers — not a slogan, the strategic idea the brand should consistently embody.

funnelTiers.desc: Lead across the entire funnel, from awareness to purchase — the benchmark for end-to-end brand effectiveness.
Smaller entry into the funnel, but strong purchase intent once a buyer actually considers them.
High awareness but limited funnel penetration — converts relatively well once considered, likely constrained by price, accessibility or niche positioning.
Well-known brands that struggle to enter buyers' active consideration set — limited ability to convert awareness into purchase intent.
